The supplied DOCX extraction contains 1917 source blocks, but only the questionnaire and SAV-backed response fields were converted into validation groups; front matter, quota text, instructions, profile descriptions, termination annotations, and duplicated TABLE_ROW representations were not treated as independent questions.

The SAV dictionary contains several source-backed variables with empty value labels, especially percentage, binary multi-response, and allocation-grid fields. Their source codes/ranges were used only where explicit questionnaire evidence supplied them; unsupported hidden constants and eligibility restrictions were not invented.
Q60 is stored as string despite a numeric-looking questionnaire prompt, so executable numeric validation was omitted.

The Q120-Q420 routed grids require explicit variable-by-variable checks or verified physical-order spans. They are preserved in the manifest but some executable checks are omitted to prevent unsafe macro ranges.
Source explicitly terminates several S10 codes; generated range check does not enforce noncontiguous eligibility codes.
S40 source states termination outside 3-35; the generated check uses the documented eligible range.
S50 and S60 contain source-specific termination rules that are not represented by the generic numeric macro.
S85 is present only in the dataset dictionary; its questionnaire source is represented by the adjacent S80/S85 material, but no independent question block was supplied.

S90 source requires at least one of codes 1-7 and rejects codes 8-9; the approved MULTI_B macro checks binary coding and selection consistency but cannot encode the source-specific termination restriction.
Q10 has an exclusive I do not know item; conditional exclusivity is not encoded because the approved macro library has no single-select exclusivity macro.
Q60 is conditional on Q50 and is stored as string in the SAV; numeric range validation is not valid for the supplied storage type, so Q60 has been omitted from executable validation.
Q80 and Q90 are routed by Q70; routing-specific requiredness is documented in the manifest, but the generic string/numeric calls do not conditionally suppress missing checks.
Source-backed Q120 variables are preserved in the manifest; executable validation is omitted to avoid an unsafe TO span.
Q130 row variables are noncontiguous by age; per-variable range checks are generated, but age-specific sum-to-100 checks are omitted.
Q190/Q200 allow up to three selections and have exclusive anchor choices; the supplied multi-response macro does not encode the maximum-three constraint or cross-question disabling.
Q210 age-group percentage items are conditional on Q110 age groups; conditional routing is retained in the manifest but not implemented in this compact draft.
Q240/Q250 allow up to three selections and have exclusive anchor choices; the supplied multi-response macro does not encode the maximum-three constraint or cross-question disabling.
The Q300 introductory text says 1-7 while the supplied SAV labels and codes are 1-5; the SAV-specific scale was used.
All Q310-Q330 variables are preserved in the manifest; executable blocks are intentionally omitted rather than validating unintended variables.
All Q340-Q420 variables are preserved in the manifest; executable validation is omitted to avoid unsafe TO spans.
Q440 and Q450 are routed by Q430=1; routing is retained in the manifest but not conditionally applied by the compact macro calls.
hidtype is dictionary-only; no questionnaire evidence supports requiredness or eligibility restrictions. The check is limited to its supplied schema codes.

B_Q120: The five age-by-medication grids contain 45 noncontiguous SAV variables; the supplied macro library requires contiguous spans and no safe contiguous span can be verified without physical dictionary order for the full grid. Generate explicit per-variable checks in a subsequent analyst revision.

B_Q310_Q330: These age-by-treatment allocation grids require routed, age-specific sum-to-100 validation and contain noncontiguous SAV variables. No safe approved macro call can be generated without unintended TO spans.

B_Q340_Q420: Alternative-profile allocation grids require routed, age-specific sum-to-100 validation across multiple noncontiguous variable families. The supplied macros cannot safely represent these grids without physical-order verification.
Analyst-reviewed draft. Static checks do not verify SPSS execution or rule correctness.
